title: Studies into the Storage of Hydrogen in Carbon Nanofibers: Proposal of a Possible Reaction Mechanism
material_description: (unlabelled 1) | herringbone carbon nanofibers grown at 873 K from ethylene over Fe/Ni/Cu catalyst 90:5:5, as prepared
source_location: Table 1 (page 202), column 'uptake-as prepared fibers'; 12 MPa and 298 K from Experimental section (pp. 202-203)
notes: Pressure 12 MPa converted to 120 bar. Temperature printed as 'ambient temperature' (p. 202) and 'obtained at 298 K' (p. 204); 298 K recorded. Single uptake value per sample, no isotherm shown; Figure 3 is uptake vs time (kinetics), not digitized. Surface area from Table 1 (N2 BET at 77 K); the table does not say whether it is for the as-prepared or Ar-treated state and the text says Ar treatment changed area by roughly 15%, so area_same_sample = unclear. BET range not stated. Sample mass 'approximately 50-100 mg' (range, not stored). Degas: vacuum ca. 10^3 Pa at 423 K (150 C = 149.85 C), duration not stated. TEM average diameter 180 nm (range 50-280 nm); carbon yield 22 g/gcat; interlayer spacing 0.34 nm. Catalyst metals not reported as retained in the sample. Basis not named; method is differential-pressure volumetric, so instrumental default excess. Convention of wt% not stated.
